relations.subject: Max Leopold Margolis
relations.role: instructor, and later assistant professor, of Hebrew language and Biblical exegesis
relations.evidence: from 1892 to 1897 he was instructor, and later assistant professor, of Hebrew language and Biblical exegesis at the Hebrew Union College of Cincinnati.

relations.subject: Max Leopold Margolis
relations.evidence: In 1897 he became assistant professor of Semitic languages in the University of California; in 1898, associate professor; and from 1902 the head of the Semitic department.
